Title: Isle Notch: Lowweight minimal dynamic island for Windows | Product Hunt
# Isle Notch. ## Lowweight minimal dynamic island for Windows. Isle sits at the top of your screen. Closed, it's a small pill with a little face. It looks around, waves when you sign in, and hides in a game or a video. Hover or click and it opens. A timer, pomodoro, and today's calendar. Drop a file or a shortcut on it and open it later. Wi-Fi, brightness, night light. Battery, and a speed check. Stick it to the top or let it float. If the face is too much, turn it off and keep the clock. Launch tags:Windows•Productivity•User Experience. Most of my evenings the last few months went into this. I wanted a Dynamic Island on Windows. The ones I tried were fine, just a strip of widgets. None of them felt like they were actually sitting there. It's a small island at the top of the screen. Closed, there's a little face. It looks around, waves when you sign in, and gets out of the way in a game or a video. Hover or click and it opens into the stuff I use every day:. * Music, with the art and real controls. Drop one on the island, open it later. * Battery, and a quick speed check. You can stick it to the top or let it float, and change the color.
